context: Riku tells Aoi about a hectic but fun day.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (死ぬ/死ん/爆/がんばっ/かける) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日、死ぬほど忙しかったよ!
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お疲れさま。がんばったね。
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活で、一生懸命がんばったんだ。
lines.en: I gave my all in club activities.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 帰り道、スマホ死んでなかった?
lines.en: Wasn't your phone dead on the way home?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、電池が死んでて焦ったよ。
lines.en: Yeah, the battery died and I panicked.
lines.style: rueful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でも、友達の話で爆笑したんでしょ?
lines.en: But you cracked up at your friend's story, right?
lines.style: giggly barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そう、爆笑して、疲れが吹き飛んだ。
lines.en: Yeah, I burst out laughing and the fatigue flew away.
lines.style: laughing teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今日は、ゆっくり時間かけて休んでね。
lines.en: Today, take your time and rest.
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm caring closing delivery throughout
